item.title: Friday Poem
item.description: Crucifixions I am not an Idealist, nor a cynic, but merely unafraid of contradictions. I have seen men face each other when both were right, yet each was determined to kill each other, which was wrong. What each man saw was an image of the other, made by someone else.
